title: Although
subtitle: 「雖然／儘管」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？
description: 「雖然／儘管」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？

words.note: 和 although 最接近的說法之一，通常可以直接互換。
words.example: Though it was raining, they continued the match.
words.exampleZh: 雖然下著雨，他們仍繼續比賽。

exercises.original: Although it was late, they continued working.
exercises.upgrade: Although it was late, they continued working.

options.explanation: 後面不能直接接完整子句。

exercises.original: Although the test was difficult, most students passed.
exercises.upgrade: Although the test was difficult, most students passed.

exercises.original: Although she was tired, she stayed until the end.
exercises.upgrade: Although she was tired, she stayed until the end.

words.note: 比 although 更強，強調前後內容有明顯反差。
words.example: Even though he was exhausted, he kept working.
words.exampleZh: 即使他筋疲力盡，仍繼續工作。

exercises.original: Although he was exhausted, he kept running.
exercises.upgrade: Although he was exhausted, he kept running.

exercises.original: Although the weather was terrible, the event continued.
exercises.upgrade: Although the weather was terrible, the event continued.

options.explanation: 強調「即使情況很差仍然」。

exercises.original: Although she knew the risks, she agreed to continue.
exercises.upgrade: Although she knew the risks, she agreed to continue.

words.note: 在正式或中性寫作中，可用來引入一個讓步或對比。
words.example: While the plan has advantages, it also carries significant risks.
words.exampleZh: 雖然這個計劃有優點，但也帶有重大風險。

exercises.original: Although the plan is useful, it is expensive.
exercises.upgrade: Although the plan is useful, it is expensive.

options.explanation: 正式地承認一點再提出限制。

exercises.original: Although the first option is cheaper, the second is more reliable.
exercises.upgrade: Although the first option is cheaper, the second is more reliable.

exercises.original: Although the evidence is limited, it still supports the main conclusion.
exercises.upgrade: Although the evidence is limited, it still supports the main conclusion.

words.note: 常用來表達兩個事實的強烈對比。
words.example: Whereas the first option is cheaper, the second is more reliable.
words.exampleZh: 雖然第一個選項較便宜，但第二個更可靠。

exercises.original: Although the first model is cheaper, the second is faster.
exercises.upgrade: Although the first model is cheaper, the second is faster.

exercises.original: Although one group improved, the other showed no change.
exercises.upgrade: Although one group improved, the other showed no change.

exercises.original: Although the north is mountainous, the south is mostly flat.
exercises.upgrade: Although the north is mountainous, the south is mostly flat.

words.note: 英式英語中可作 while 的較正式變體。
words.example: Whilst the proposal is ambitious, it may be difficult to implement.
words.exampleZh: 雖然這個提案很有抱負，但可能難以實施。

exercises.original: Although the proposal is ambitious, it may be difficult to implement.
exercises.upgrade: Although the proposal is ambitious, it may be difficult to implement.

exercises.original: Although the service is reliable, it is relatively expensive.
exercises.upgrade: Although the service is reliable, it is relatively expensive.

exercises.original: Although the data are incomplete, they are still useful.
exercises.upgrade: Although the data are incomplete, they are still useful.

words.note: 和 although 很接近，但結構更長、更正式。
words.example: Despite the fact that the road was closed, some drivers tried to continue.
words.exampleZh: 儘管道路已封閉，仍有一些司機試圖繼續前進。

exercises.original: Although the road was closed, some drivers continued.
exercises.upgrade: Although the road was closed, some drivers continued.

options.explanation: 後面不能這樣直接接完整 clause。

exercises.original: Although she was nervous, she spoke clearly.
exercises.upgrade: Although she was nervous, she spoke clearly.

exercises.original: Although the product is expensive, demand remains strong.
exercises.upgrade: Although the product is expensive, demand remains strong.

words.word: In spite of the fact that
words.note: 和 despite the fact that 幾乎相同。
words.example: In spite of the fact that she was nervous, she gave an excellent presentation.
words.exampleZh: 儘管她很緊張，她仍做了一場出色的簡報。

exercises.original: Although the team was inexperienced, it performed well.
exercises.upgrade: Although the team was inexperienced, it performed well.
exercises.answer: in spite of the fact that

options.text: in spite of the fact that

exercises.original: Although the weather was cold, the beach was crowded.
exercises.upgrade: Although the weather was cold, the beach was crowded.
exercises.answer: in spite of the fact that

options.text: in spite of the fact that

exercises.original: Although he had little time, he finished the task.
exercises.upgrade: Although he had little time, he finished the task.
exercises.answer: in spite of the fact that

options.text: in spite of the fact that

words.note: 表示先承認某一點成立，再提出另一個限制或反駁。
words.example: Granted that the project is expensive, it could still save money in the long term.
words.exampleZh: 即使承認這個項目很昂貴，長遠而言仍可能省錢。

exercises.original: Although the project is expensive, it could save money later.
exercises.upgrade: Although the project is expensive, it could save money later.

options.explanation: 先承認缺點，再提出反方觀點。

exercises.original: Although the evidence is limited, the conclusion is still plausible.
exercises.upgrade: Although the evidence is limited, the conclusion is still plausible.

exercises.original: Although the proposal is imperfect, it is better than the alternatives.
exercises.upgrade: Although the proposal is imperfect, it is better than the alternatives.

words.note: 常用在正式寫作中，先承認一個事實，再補充轉折。
words.example: Admittedly, the system is expensive, but it is extremely reliable.
words.exampleZh: 誠然，這個系統很昂貴，但它非常可靠。

exercises.original: Although the system is expensive, it is reliable.
exercises.upgrade: Although the system is expensive, it is reliable.

options.explanation: 句法不同，但讓步功能高度接近。

exercises.original: Although the journey was long, it was worth it.
exercises.upgrade: Although the journey was long, it was worth it.

exercises.original: Although the method is simple, it is not always effective.
exercises.upgrade: Although the method is simple, it is not always effective.

words.note: 常用於較自然或稍文學化的表達，尤其表示「雖然我很……」。
words.example: Much as I like the idea, I don't think we can afford it.
words.exampleZh: 雖然我很喜歡這個想法，但我不認為我們負擔得起。

exercises.original: Although I like the idea, I don't think we can afford it.
exercises.upgrade: Although I like the idea, I don't think we can afford it.

options.explanation: 自然表達「雖然我很喜歡」。

exercises.original: Although she wanted to stay, she had to leave.
exercises.upgrade: Although she wanted to stay, she had to leave.

options.explanation: 帶有「雖然非常想」的感覺。

exercises.original: Although we respect his experience, we disagree with his conclusion.
exercises.upgrade: Although we respect his experience, we disagree with his conclusion.

options.explanation: 較成熟自然的讓步句型。

words.note: 較書面或稍舊式，表示「即使前面是真的，後面仍然成立」。
words.example: For all that he had little experience, he performed remarkably well.
words.exampleZh: 儘管他經驗不多，表現卻非常出色。

exercises.original: Although he had little experience, he performed well.
exercises.upgrade: Although he had little experience, he performed well.

options.explanation: 較書面、較少見，但語義成立。

exercises.original: Although the plan was complicated, it succeeded.
exercises.upgrade: Although the plan was complicated, it succeeded.

exercises.original: Although she appeared calm, she was worried.
exercises.upgrade: Although she appeared calm, she was worried.

options.explanation: 成立，但比 although 更書面。

words.note: 常見固定表達，用來承認前面的觀點後，轉回自己的主要論點。
words.example: The plan may be popular. Be that as it may, we still need to examine the cost.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃可能很受歡迎。即便如此，我們仍需要審視成本。

exercises.original: The plan may be popular. Although that is true, we still need to examine the cost.
exercises.upgrade: The plan may be popular. Although that is true, we still need to examine the cost.

exercises.original: He has a lot of experience. Although that is true, the evidence does not support his claim.
exercises.upgrade: He has a lot of experience. Although that is true, the evidence does not support his claim.

options.explanation: 承認前點，但不改變主結論。

exercises.original: The product is cheaper. Although that is true, the alternative is more reliable.
exercises.upgrade: The product is cheaper. Although that is true, the alternative is more reliable.

words.note: 常見自然表達，用來承認前一句後加入轉折。
words.example: The software is easy to use. That said, it lacks several important features.
words.exampleZh: 這個軟件很容易使用。話雖如此，它缺少幾項重要功能。

exercises.original: The software is easy to use. Although that is true, it lacks several features.
exercises.upgrade: The software is easy to use. Although that is true, it lacks several features.

exercises.original: The hotel is expensive. Although that is true, the service is excellent.
exercises.upgrade: The hotel is expensive. Although that is true, the service is excellent.

exercises.original: The evidence is limited. Although that is true, the pattern is still interesting.
exercises.upgrade: The evidence is limited. Although that is true, the pattern is still interesting.

words.note: 表示即使前面的情況成立，後面的結果仍不變。
words.example: The weather was terrible. All the same, we had a good time.
words.exampleZh: 天氣很差。儘管如此，我們仍玩得很開心。

exercises.original: The weather was terrible. Although that was true, we had a good time.
exercises.upgrade: The weather was terrible. Although that was true, we had a good time.

options.explanation: 表示儘管如此，結果仍然。

exercises.original: The task was difficult. Although that was true, she finished it on time.
exercises.upgrade: The task was difficult. Although that was true, she finished it on time.

exercises.original: The route was longer. Although that was true, it was much safer.
exercises.upgrade: The route was longer. Although that was true, it was much safer.

options.explanation: 即使前面成立，後面的評價仍成立。

falseSynonyms.zh: 因為不等於雖然 because 表示原因；although 表示讓步。
falseSynonyms.point: Because it was raining, we stayed inside. Although it was raining, we went outside.

falseSynonyms.zh: 但是不完全等於 although however 是副詞／連接副詞，通常連接兩個獨立句子。 功能接近，但句法不同。
falseSynonyms.point: Although it was expensive, we bought it. It was expensive. However, we bought it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 儘管，但後面不能直接接完整子句 不能說：
falseSynonyms.point: Despite the rain, we went out. Although it was raining, we went out. ❌ Despite it was raining

falseSynonyms.zh: 和 despite 一樣，後面通常接名詞或動名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: In spite of being tired, she continued.

falseSynonyms.zh: 非常接近讓步轉折，但通常不是從屬連接詞。
falseSynonyms.point: Although it was risky, they continued. It was risky. Nevertheless, they continued.
